title: adenostyles albifrons subsp. pyrenaica
intro:
Adenostyles albifrons subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as the Pyrenean hoary cress, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Adenostyles albifrons subsp. pyrenaica include its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: Please note that more research is needed to confirm the effectiveness of Adenostyles albifrons subsp. pyrenaica for the mentioned health benefits and therapeutic actions.
